<function name="DoClick" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelhook">
	<description>
Called when the node is clicked.

See also <page>DTree_Node:DoRightClick</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to prevent DoClick from being called on parent nodes or the <page>DTree</page> itself.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
